# Lens — `duplication`

Purpose: Repeated authored behavior or facts that produce inconsistent fixes and maintenance.

Identify both authored sources, their common obligation, and the concrete inconsistency or maintenance consequence. Trace generated provenance before reporting a duplicate. Prefer an existing owner when a demonstrated duplicate can reference it.

Exclusions: Generated mirrors, deliberate specializations, and similar text with different obligations.
